result.instruction: In `rr_arbiter4`, replace the `case (last)` priority chains, binary `winner` selection, and subsequent winner-based payload `case` with explicit one-hot winner terms for each cyclic priority state. Use those terms to select `addr` and `data` with masked ORs, and to register the matching one-hot grant and winning `last` value. Preserve registered outputs, reset behavior, idle-cycle zeroing, and round-robin behavior; keep the top unannotated and judge the candidate on routed LUTs plus setup and hold slack.
